title: A scoop with a view.
summary: Rococo Ice Cream: a changing flavor board and a little stop worth keeping simple.
search: The journal/Kennebunk, MaineA New England field note · Kennebunk, MaineA scoop with a view.Rococo Ice Cream: a changing flavor board and a little stop worth keeping simple.The little storyThe simple planGetting thereAccess & facilitiesHours & linksPrint the guideThe little address bookRococoIce Cream8 Western AvenueKennebunk, MaineSee the scoop shop’s own photographs ↗A Maine coast afternoon leaves plenty of room for ice cream, especially when choosing a flavor becomes a small adventure of its own. At Rococo in Kennebunk, the possibilities reach beyond the familiar: goat cheese with blackberry and Chambord, strawberry with basil, maple and fig with a little jalapeño heat. These are examples from the maker’s repertoire; let today’s scoop board make the final introduction.That curiosity has roots in Buenos Aires. Founder Lauren Guptill, a tenth-generation Mainer, spent several years in Argentina before opening Rococo in 2012.
